items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'he' (George Pops Foster) in the third person, referring to his plans and behavior ('His head is too big'), indicating no direct personal interaction or relationship with the named person 'Josh'.

ctx.x: Man, he come out here with an order band and then went- I went back. And he's about to come out here and buy a chicken for him. Yeah.

He was in New Orleans all winter. And his sister is very sick, so he was going to come over here in the spring. First, going to come in April, right after Mardi Gras. And I saw him in May. He said he's going to leave about the first of June he'd be here. I don't know. I guess down south, probably. Nice plan, Josh. Huh? Nice plan.
Nice plan. Where? Broke, nice plan. No, he talks. No, he's talking. No, he's talking. His head is too big. His head is good. Like you say, when he was with Ellington, he never does it.
